task.title: Managing builds by using the Red Hat Quay API
task.shortdesc: To list, activate, start, update, or delete build triggers in Red Hat Quay, you can use the build trigger API endpoints with an OAuth access token.

ul.li: You have created an OAuth access token.

step.cmd: Use the GET /api/v1/repository/{repository}/trigger/ endpoint to list the triggers for the specified repository:

info.codeblock: {"triggers": [{"id": "32ca5eae-a29f-46c7-8f44-3221ca417c92", "service": "custom-git", "is_active": false, "build_source": null, "repository_url": null, "config": {}, "can_invoke": true, "enabled": true, "disabled_reason": null}]}

step.cmd: Use the POST /api/v1/repository/{repository}/trigger/{trigger_uuid}/activate endpoint to activate the specified build trigger.
Use the POST /api/v1/repository/{repository}/trigger/{trigger_uuid}/start endpoint to manually start the build from the specified trigger:
Use the GET /api/v1/repository/{repository}/trigger/{trigger_uuid}/builds endpoint to list the builds started by the specified trigger:
Use the GET /api/v1/repository/{repository}/trigger/{trigger_uuid} endpoint to get information for the specified build trigger:
Use the PUT /api/v1/repository/{repository}/trigger/{trigger_uuid} endpoint to update the specified build trigger:
Use the DELETE /api/v1/repository/{repository}/trigger/{trigger_uuid} endpoint to delete the specified build trigger:
